title: 第十章火弹术第十一章面具人
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: “江师弟，莫要着急。”
江离刚一转身，宋展就叫住了他。
实际上在江离拿出凝血金丹那一刻，宋展就已经打算要和江离交换了。
江离注意到了小月宗近日的异常之处，身为在小月宗呆了这么长时间的老人，宋展怎么可能注意不到。
不论这凝血金丹价值几何，可若是真出了事，这可是有望救命的东西。
什么样的价值能比自己的小命还要值钱？
宋展之所以说一枚凝血金丹的价值不够，自然还是想要诈一诈江离。
若能诈出更多好处，自然更好。
若是江离身上真没了其他好处，仅是一枚凝血金丹，他也不亏。
江离转身，却见宋展一脸肉疼之相。
“一枚凝血金丹换一门术法，价值确实不够。可毕竟我们师兄弟一场，有时也不能只看利益。这样吧，既然你需要一门术法，那便换了便是。”
“那就多谢宋展师兄了。”
江离面露喜色，谢过宋展。
两人交换，江离抱着术法回到自己房间。
宋展给江离的这门术法名为火弹术，修行之后可以自身灵力凝聚出一个炙热火球，外放攻击敌人。
别看这只是低阶术法而已，威力却是非同小可。
其凝聚出的火球并非普通火焰，一般的水根本浇不灭。
而且火球触碰到敌人后还会爆裂，除了爆炸那一下可以带来伤害之外，爆炸后的火焰还能附着在敌人身上，轻易无法扑灭。
最重要的是，此门术法是一种远程攻击手段。
只要修炼有成，便可以攻击到五丈范围内的敌人。
并且随着不断修炼，攻击距离也会增加。
火弹术一共分为五层。
修炼至小成，也便是第一层，一次可以释放一颗火弹。
修炼至二层，便可同时释放三颗火弹。
到了第三层，不仅同时可以释放五颗火弹，并且还可以用神念控制火弹改变方向，不再像前二层那般直来直去。
对敌时，对方想要躲开攻击就变得更加困难。
修到第四层大成，则是九颗火弹。
而到了第五层，将此术法修至圆满，便可直接凝聚出一片火雨，覆盖一片范围。
只不过这门术法的后三层，还需要修为来支持，必须要达到炼气期五层，能做到神念外放后才行。
无论怎么说，这一门术法对于现阶段的江离来讲，极为实用。
江离先把这火弹术的修行诀窍记住，然后便开始在自己屋里修炼起来。
至于为什么不放进木盒之中？
这门术法十分完整，没有丝毫缺失。
江离早已测试过，木盒只能补全残缺，把完整的东西放进去不会有任何作用。
所以江离也不需要再等一个晚上，直接拿来修炼即可。
content_en:
"Junior Brother Jiang, don't be anxious."
As soon as Jiang Li turned around, Song Zhan stopped him.
In fact, the moment Jiang Li took out the blood coagulation elixir, Song Zhan had already planned to exchange it with Jiang Li.
Jiang Li noticed something unusual about Xiaoyue Sect recently. As an old man who had stayed in Xiaoyue Sect for such a long time, how could Song Zhan not notice it.
No matter how valuable this blood coagulation elixir is, if something happens, it can be a life-saving thing.
What kind of value is more valuable than your own life?
The reason why Song Zhan said that a blood-coagulating golden elixir was not valuable enough was because he naturally wanted to deceive Jiang Li.
It would be better if more benefits can be defrauded.
If Jiang Li really had no other benefits and only had a blood-coagulating golden elixir, he wouldn't be at a loss.
Jiang Li turned around and saw Song Zhan with a look of pain on his face.
"The value of a blood-coagulating golden elixir for a magic spell is indeed not enough. But after all, we senior brothers sometimes can't just look at the benefits. Well, since you need a magic spell, just change it."
"Thank you very much, Senior Brother Song Zhan."
Jiang Li looked happy and thanked Song Zhan.
The two exchanged words, and Jiang Li returned to his room holding the technique.
The technique that Song Zhan gave to Jiang Li is called the Fire Ball Technique. After practicing it, he can condense his own spiritual power into a scorching fireball and release it to attack the enemy.
Even though this is just a low-level spell, its power is extraordinary.
The fireball it condenses is no ordinary flame, and ordinary water cannot extinguish it.
Moreover, the fireball will explode when it touches the enemy. In addition to the damage caused by the explosion, the flames after the explosion can also attach to the enemy and cannot be extinguished easily.
The most important thing is that this technique is a long-range attack method.
As long as you practice successfully, you can attack enemies within five feet.
And with continuous practice, the attack distance will also increase.
The fire bomb technique is divided into five levels.
After practicing to a small level, which is the first level, you can release one fire bomb at a time.
After practicing to the second level, you can release three fire bombs at the same time.
On the third floor, not only can five fire bombs be released at the same time, but also the fire bombs can be controlled to change direction with spiritual thoughts, no longer as straight as the first two floors.
When facing an enemy, it becomes more difficult for the opponent to dodge the attack.
When you reach the fourth level of cultivation, you will have nine fire bombs.
And when you reach the fifth level, if you practice this technique to perfection, you can directly condense a rain of fire to cover an area.
However, the last three levels of this technique still require cultivation to support it. It must reach the fifth level of Qi refining stage and be able to release spiritual thoughts.
No matter what, this technique is extremely practical for Jiang Li at this stage.
Jiang Li first memorized the training tips of the Fire Bullet Technique, and then began to practice it in his room.
As for why not put it in a wooden box?
This technique is very complete, without any defects.
Jiang Li had already tested it. The wooden box could only make up for the missing parts. Putting complete things in it would not have any effect.
So Jiang Li didn't need to wait another night, he could just use it to practice directly.
